text: タマムシの　リーダー　エリカは　しぜんと　こころを　かよわす　しょくぶつ　ポケモンの　つかいて！

structure.jp: タマムシの　リーダー　エリカは
しぜんと　こころを　かよわす
structure.en: who shares her heart with nature

structure.jp: しょくぶつ　ポケモンの　つかいて！
structure.en: is a user of plant Pokémon!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: しぜんと　こころを　かよわす　しょくぶつ　ポケモンの　つかいて
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a name of a thing describes it. しぜんと　こころを　かよわす　しょくぶつ　ポケモンの　つかいて = 'a plant Pokémon user who is in tune with nature'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と here means 'with', showing who the heart is shared with. しぜんと = 'with nature'.
